name: Hershel Layton
original_name: エルシャール・レイトン
source:
Professor Hershel Layton is a famous archaeology professor with a fascination with puzzles. His love of puzzles has solved numerous mysteries and put his name in the papers many times. He travels with his apprentice [url=https://vndb.org/c17637]Luke Triton[/url].

Under mysterious circumstances, both Triton and himself were transported to Labyrinthia, as were [url=https://vndb.org/c3941]Phoenix Wright[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c3944]Maya Fey[/url]. 

[spoiler]While in Labyrinthia, Layton was apparently turned to gold by the spell "Goldor". Fey was accused of being the "witch" responsible and was put on trial, though Wright was able to prove her innocence.

It was later revealed that Layton was still alive; the "spell" simply consisted of the Shades removing Layton from the scene and placing a statue in his image in his place.

Later, when [url=https://vndb.org/c17638]Espella Cantabella[/url] was tried for being the Great Witch Bezella, High Inquisitor [url=https://vndb.org/c17640]Darklaw[/url], who was in charge of the case, was called to give testimony. Layton filled the vacant inquisitor's bench to help Wright get to the truth behind Labyrinthia.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Hershel_Layton]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url]]

With his actions and his personality, he is the epitomy of an english gentleman.

The height noted includes his hat; his height from head to toe is unknown.
